A '''skirmish''' occurred between [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Progga]] in his [[Progga's starship|starship]] and [[Dubrak Qennto]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'', it took place in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], specifically in an [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two)|unidentified star system]], and in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], as Qennto and his starship were able to escape through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and the Hutt tracked them. However, when Progga was going to destroy Dubrak, [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] forces fired a [[Conner net]] at both starships, which prompted Progga to defend himself, and enter a skirmish against the Chiss.

==Prelude==
A '''skirmish''' started when [[Progga]] in [[Progga's starship|his starship]] attacked the ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'' which had [[Dubrak Qennto]] as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and a crew consisting of [[Maris Ferasi]] and [[Jorj Car'das]]. Progga did this in an attempt to hijack the ''Bargain Hunter'' and steal their cargo of rare furs and [[Firegem]]s.<ref name="OBF" />

==The Battle==
Progga tracked Qennto twice through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] but he was never able to hit the ''Bargain Hunter'' directly with his ship's blaster fire. The second time the ''Bargain Hunter'' made a hyperspace jump to try and get away its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] over heated because of a nullifier problem and finally, after over four hour of working, Quennto got it shut down without slagging it. The ''Bargain Hunter'' ended up near a [[Unidentified star cluster (Unknown Regions)|star cluster]]. They decided to use their backup hyperdrive to make a jump to the nearest [[Unidentified Unknown Regions star system (skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two)|star system]] which was a fourth [[Light-year/Legends|light-year]] away. They came out near a yellow [[Unidentified yellow sun|sun]] but were unpleasantly surprised when Progga showed up right behind them and hailed them over the ships' comm systems. Progga mistakenly assumed they had a hidden base on the nearby planet and demanded for Quennto to lead him to it.<ref name="OBF" />

==Aftermath==
Before Progga and Qennto finished talking the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] fired a [[Conner net]] at both of the ships. While the ''Bargain Hunter'' was place out of commission, [[Progga's starship]] was built to resist the Conner nets. Progga, prepared to fight, turned his starship around to confront the beings who had launched the nets, and what issued was the [[Skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two]].<ref name="OBF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skirmish between Progga and the Bargain Hunter was described in [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]] in 2006, but it was not given a name.
